text:
alex: Heads-up — starting a 2-hour soft-hold for v1.12.0 RC prep at ~1769997921 (roughly 2h). Please avoid non-critical merges into release/* branches. If you need a late merge, open an exception request and ping me with: reason, rollback plan, and CI status. :thumbsup:

taylor: quick question — docs-only PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6162) — changelog entry added. Is that allowed under soft-hold?

alex: docs-only is usually fine as long as: 1) changelog snippet present, 2) PR labeled `docs`, 3) owner signs off. Leave a short release-notes line in the PR description. I'll rubber-stamp after a quick review. :ok_hand:

morgan: I need an exception. PR #6127 is a runtime KV-cache eviction fix. It improves steady-state perf but touches core runtime paths. I opened exception ticket: https://internal/exception/987 — CI is green on branch, but want oncall ack.

alex: Morgan — exception checklist (minimal):
- one-sentence risk summary + why we can’t wait for next release
- revert plan (commit to revert + who will revert)
- `git cherry-pick -x <commit>` instructions included
- CI: all checks pass on release branch (link)
- oncall ack in thread
Post that to the exception tracker and ping me. If all true, I’ll approve and request a canary deploy to staging.

sam: release-bot: Scheduled canary deploy to `staging` at 2026-03-18T03:00Z for v1.12.0-rc1. Monitor perf and error rate for first 30m. :robot_face:

lia: Oncall here — I ran the perf smoke on the PR branch: `scripts/smoke.sh --staging` -> brief: latency p50 +2ms, p95 unchanged, no OOM. I’ll watch the canary and post logs. :eyes:

alex: If we approve the exception, please also: add a concise changelog entry (1-2 lines), tag the PR `release-candidate` and update the release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/v1.12.0-draft. For cherry-pick:```bash
git checkout release/v1.12
git pull origin release/v1.12
git cherry-pick -x 9f2a7d3
# push and open a backport PR: gh pr create --base release/v1.12 --head backport/9f2a7d3 --title "cherry-pick: kv cache fix"
```

morgan: thanks — added changelog snippet and revert plan to the exception. Oncall acked. PR backport created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6180.

release-bot: Exception 987 approved by @alex. Canary deploy initiated to staging. Monitoring hooks active.

alex: Great — once staging canary is green for 30m, we’ll lift the soft-hold for this PR only and merge into release branch. Everyone else: please hold other mergers until RC tag is cut unless explicit approval given.

taylor: thanks — merging docs PR shortly. :sparkles:

sam: Note: after merging, remember to run `tools/update-buildstamp.sh v1.12.0-rc1` and add the RC tag. I can handle tagging when we give go.

alex: Perfect. I'll post a final all-clear or extended hold if we see anomalies. Ping me for any blocking emergency merges.
